remarks: Welcome to 277 South Bald Hill, New Canaan, CT,, a stunning 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom house that's been thoughtfully updated. This property is ideal for families, first-time homebuyers, or empty nesters looking to downsize in style.As you step into this beautifully renovated home, you'll be greeted by interiors freshly painted offering a clean canvas for your personal touch. Each room is a potential showcase for your home furnishings and accessories, ensuring that you can easily make this house your own.The home boasts three new remodelled bathrooms, complete with new vanities, flooring, and chic decorative lighting. Attention to detail is evident throughout the updates, blending functionality with style.Set on a generous, 4.33 acre plot that has recently cleared almost an acre of land creating more open and recreational space , with plenty of room for outdoor activities and entertaining.Enjoy water views from every room in the back of the house overlooking a pond framed by the natural landscape. This idyllic setting offers privacy and the opportunity to savor the beauty of each season. Rest assured, the home is well maintained with essential updates, including a full house generator, a recently updated furnace, new electrical panels, water filtration system, just to name a few. New Canaan boasts the number 1 ranking in the state for all three elementary schools and 1 school district in CT! The downtown offers high restaurants and luxury shopping and easy commute to NYC.
